name: international-patient-summary
description: International Patient Summary (IPS): an introduction in 45 locales, its website, a browser viewer (frontend), a storage service (backend), and iOS and Android apps.

Projects.name: Website
Projects.description: SvelteKit 3 + Lily Design System site on GitHub Pages; builds its own llms.txt

Projects.name: Viewer (frontend)
Projects.description: Svelte 5 IPS viewer with JSON/YAML/Markdown/PDF export and a backendless tour

Projects.name: Service (backend)
Projects.description: Rust Axum + Axa 0.16 + sqlx + Postgres store for IPS document Bundles

Projects.name: iOS app
Projects.description: Swift + UIKit (no SwiftUI) IPS viewer; in memory only, no network

Projects.name: Android app
Projects.description: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose IPS viewer; in memory only, no network

Projects.name: Mobile app translations
Projects.description: Both mobile apps' strings in 65 languages, and the script that writes them in
